params:
  padj: 0.05

  out_file: "test_files/ora_test.tsv"
---

This notebook takes Wilcoxon test statistics and dPSI values for query and reference groups chosen in `scripts/06-diffsplice_calculation.R` as input. After filtering for splice events with user-defined padj and dPSI thresholds, this notebook performs over-representation analysis (ORA) on the parent genes of the filtered splice events.

Caveats:

- The input to this notebook is currently the AML (stranded) vs. Whole Blood (unstranded) diffsplice results so doesn't reflect the biological comparison we want to make for the manuscript.

## Setup

Load libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
```

Define directory and file paths

```{r}
## directories
# repo root
repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)

## files
# whole blood vs AML splice results with gene name, median PSI, diffsplice dpsi, and p-adj columns
diffsplice_results_file <- file.path(repo_root, params$in_file)

# output ORA results
out_file <- file.path(repo_root, params$out_file)
```

Read in files

```{r}
diffsplice_results <- readr::read_tsv(diffsplice_results_file) 
```

## ORA

### Retrieve gene lists from splice results for ORA

Background genes (`detected_genes`) are all genes with non-NA (numeric) PSI values quantified for at least min_samples in the reference and query groups. In the test data used here, min_samples was 5.

```{r}
detected_genes <- diffsplice_results |>
  # remove NA p values, as they are present in the diffsplice data frame
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_adj)) |>
  # extract gene names column for ORA
  dplyr::pull(gene_names) |>
  # take unique set of parent genes
  unique()
```

Filter for differential splicing results within padj and significance thresholds and obtain the diffsplice gene list

```{r}
# filter for significant diffsplice evennts
filtered_diffsplice_results <- diffsplice_results |>
  dplyr::filter(
    p_adj < params$padj,
    abs(dPSI) > params$dpsi
  ) |>
  # rank significant diff splice events by abs(dPSI)
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(dPSI)))

# obtain vector of significant diffsplice parent genes
diffsplice_genes <- unique(filtered_diffsplice_results$gene_names)
```

### ORA on significantly differentially spliced genes

Using the BP gene set, `pvaluecutoff` 0.05, and `qvaluecutoff` 0.05, only 1 gene set is returned as enriched in splicing `(regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction`).

Using ALL gene sets, 21 are returned with these thresholds. The AML vs. Whole Blood comparison is one of the ref/query pairs that had the most samples, so I will leave the gene sets as ALL here since I now expect most ref/query pairs to return very few significantly overrepresented genes.

```{r}
go_enrich <- enrichGO(gene = diffsplice_genes,
                      universe = detected_genes,
                      OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                      keyType = 'SYMBOL',
                      readable = T,
                      ont = c("ALL"),
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                      qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

```

## Plot ORA results

Plot overlapping genes in each gene set with an upset plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4

upsetplot(go_enrich) +
  ggtitle("Overlap of genes in ORA gene sets for AML vs Whole Blood")
```

Plot gene set gene count and significance from ORA: dot plot of gene set gene abundance (gene ratio) and ORA p values

```{r}
dotplot(go_enrich)
```

## Write output to file

```{r write_output}
readr::write_tsv(as.data.frame(go_enrich), out_file)
```
